rawFindings.title: Incorrect param key assignment in Layer.match()
rawFindings.explanation: The patch changed the for-loop in Layer.prototype.match() to always use key.name as the param key, but previously it would fall back to incremental keys for unnamed capture groups. This breaks routes with unnamed parameters (e.g., using '*' wildcard or capture groups before named params), causing req.params to miss or mis-map parameters.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore fallback for param keys when keys[i - 1] is undefined, assigning incremental numeric keys to params accordingly as in the original code.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: A route such as '/*/user/:id' with a request to '/1/user/2' produces params: { id: '2' }, missing the '0' param for '1', breaking expected param mapping.
